name: Index Town Walls lot, large lot just south of town below the Lower Town Wall
basis: Mountain Project Index 'Getting There': for Lower Town Wall, Inner Walls, Side Walls, Mid Walls and Upper Town Wall park in the large lot south of town just below the LTW; Backpacker: large lot a quarter mile west of town. Mapped entry is named Index Town Walls Parking Area and sits ~10 m from the Crescent Trail end at the LTW (road check).

name: Index town parking by Crescent Street, near the Index-Galena Road
basis: Mountain Project Index 'Getting There': for Lookout Point and Diamond areas drive through town to the T-intersection and park around there; later revision: street parking on Crescent Street just west of the tracks. Road check: this mapped lot is 0.19 km from Crescent Street and 0.04 km from Index-Galena Road in town; the other candidate lots are 0.9 km+ away.

name: Index town parking by Crescent Street, near the Index-Galena Road
basis: Same text as Lookout Point: Diamond and Lookout Point areas park in town near the T-intersection / Crescent Street. Road check: lot 0.19 km from Crescent Street.

name: Reiter Road pullout (about 2.8 mi up), Discover Pass required
basis: Mountain Project Gold Bar area: one parks at the 2.6 or 2.8 mile pullout off Reiter Rd; second pullout leads to Five Star Boulder; display Discover Pass. Road check: this mapped lot is 0.01 km from Reiter Road, 0.5 km from the Five Star Boulder. Which pullout serves each sector is not stated, so only the destination-level boulder area is assigned.

name: Lake Serene / Bridal Veil Falls trailhead lot off Mount Index Road (Forest Pass)
basis: WDFW and WTA: Lake Serene trailhead and large lot ~500 ft past the Lake Serene Trail 1068 spur off Mount Index Road; shoreline boulders are reached by that trail; Northwest Forest Pass. Mapped entry is named Lake Serene Trailhead Parking, ~100 m from the mapped trailhead node.
